module: Crawling zone marker (rock crawling) in play mode: a floating icon above a spherical zone. The player's vehicle entering the sphere (center of its bounding box within radius, 2 m by default) raises the icon and makes it interactive (list of activities to accept). The module returns {create, cluster}: cluster groups the crawlMarker POIs, create builds the marker object (class C).
notes: cluster groups the POIs with the same pos and the same iconPos (key = tostring(pos)..tostring(iconPos)); the default icon is mission_rockcrawling01_triangle.
POIs must provide markerInfo.crawlMarker with pos, radius, iconPos and icon (optional); cluster.elemData takes poi.data of each POI.
The icon is only visible if the camera is within 35 m and a static ray (castRayStatic) does not hit an obstacle; it is hidden when the big map is active.
isInAreaChanged is "in" or "out" for one frame when entering/leaving a zone, otherwise nil.
update does nothing if the player has no vehicle (data.veh nil); walking is not required.
drawAxisBox draws a debug box (debugDrawer) but is not called anywhere in this file.

create.desc: Builds a crawling marker object (instance of C) and calls init.

cluster.desc: Groups identical crawlMarker POIs (same pos and iconPos) into clusters and adds them to allClusters.

allClusters.desc: List of clusters completed in place.

C.desc: Crawling zone marker with animated icon.

setup.desc: Reads pos, rot, scl from the cluster and creates the icon (id <cluster.id>-gsIcon) with its smoothers; icon offset 0.5 m, lift 1.0 m.

update.desc: Every frame: tests entry into the sphere, animates the icon's height and opacity, draws a line when the icon is raised, updates isInAreaChanged, anyOverlap.

data.desc: Frame data: veh, bbCenter, camPos, dt, bigMapActive.

createObjects.desc: Cleans up existing objects (does not create new ones).

hide.desc: Becomes invisible and sets the icon opacity to 0.

clearObjects.desc: Removes the icon from the icon renderer and clears triggerArea.

interactInPlayMode.desc: If canInteract and the player is in the zone, adds the cluster's data (elemData) to the list of interactive elements.

drawAxisBox.desc: Draws an axis-aligned box (semi-transparent edges and faces) via debugDrawer; debug utility.

drawOnMinimap.desc: Draws a circle at the icon's position on the minimap (ui_apps_minimap_utils.simpleCircle).
